name: MND Australia information resources library
description: Central MND Australia library containing factsheets, guides, booklets, videos, communication tools, My Care Needs, bedside alert, wallet card and other practical downloadable resources.
care_team_notes: Use this as the main MND-specific resource directory; cite the exact linked document and retrieval date when recommending a printable tool or guide.

name: My Care Needs form
description: Interactive and printable MND care-needs form for recording personal care, communication, mobility, nutrition, breathing, equipment and preference information for hospital, emergency, home or provider handover.
care_team_notes: Recommend completing with the person, carer, MND advisor and relevant clinicians; keep updated copies in the emergency bag, at home and with hospital/provider contacts.

name: MND Hospital Bedside Alert
description: Printable alert form intended to tell ward, respite or home-care staff about high-priority MND care needs at the bedside.
care_team_notes: Pair with My Care Needs and local hospital admission notes; review after changes in breathing, swallowing, communication, transfers or equipment.

name: MND communication tools and boards
description: MND communication guides, partner-assisted scanning resources, communication boards, AAC planning guides, wallet card and phone wallpaper for when speech changes.
care_team_notes: Suggest speech pathologist review and keep low-tech backup boards available even when high-tech AAC is used.

name: Carer Gateway emergency care plan
description: Blank emergency care plan and carer emergency cards for recording emergency contacts, care needs, medical information, medicines and backup support arrangements.
care_team_notes: Useful when the main carer becomes unavailable; keep copies with emergency contacts and update after medicine, provider or care-routine changes.

name: NDIS booklets and factsheets
description: Current NDIS factsheets, participant booklets, Easy Read files, DOCX/PDF downloads and forms for applying, planning, using a plan, changing a plan and recording providers.
care_team_notes: NDIS pages can change with legislation; use the retrieval date and link the exact PDF/DOCX source when answering.

name: NDIS access request and supporting evidence
description: NDIS access request information and supporting evidence form pathway for applying to the NDIS and documenting disability-related functional impact.
care_team_notes: For MND, evidence often needs diagnosis, functional impact and likely progressive support needs; refer clinical wording to treating health professionals.

name: Healthdirect Service Finder
description: Australian health service directory for finding doctors, pharmacies, hospitals and other health services.
care_team_notes: Use as a directory source, not as personalised referral advice; encourage users to confirm availability, accessibility and fees directly with services.

name: My Aged Care assessment and referral pathways
description: Assessment application and referral information for older Australians needing home support, short-term care, residential care, end-of-life care or urgent support.
care_team_notes: Use the age and urgent-care context carefully; for urgent services or existing assessed clients, cite the My Aged Care instructions rather than assuming the online form is correct.
